newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea names new military chief.
newsitem.headline: South Korea names new military chief.

text.p: South Korea announced a replacement on Thursday for its top military commander whose two-year term expires this year.
Kim Dong-jin, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, will be replaced by Yoon Young-nam, currently Chief of Staff of the Republic of Korea army.
Yoon will be succeeded by Do Il-kyu, presently commander of the Third Republic of Korea Army.
A defence ministry statement did not say when the new appointments would take effect.
South Korea's military has come under heavy criticism for failing to detect a North Korean submarine that intruded into southern waters last month.
Of 26 North Koreans who landed from the vessel, 22 have been killed, prompting threats of "merciless retaliation" by Pyongyang.
